act_name: West Pakistan Survey and Rectangulation of Lands Ordinance, 1959
heading: Short title, extent and commencement
title: Short title, extent and commencement
text:
1. Short title, extent and commencement. (1) This Ordinance may be called the West Pakistan Survey and Rectangulation of Lands Ordinance, 1959.
(2) It extends to the whole of the Province of West Pakistan, except the Tribal Areas.
(3) It shall come into force in such area and on such date as the Board of Revenue, West Pakistan, may by notification direct.

act_name: West Pakistan Survey and Rectangulation of Lands Ordinance, 1959
heading: Power to direct survey and rectangulation
title: Power to direct survey and rectangulation
text: 2. Power to direct survey and rectangulation. Notwithstanding anything contained in any other law for the time being in force, the Board of Revenue, West Pakistan, may, by notification, direct that survey and rectangulation of land in any area be carried out; provided that, as far as possible, the area of an owner’s holding shall not, as a result of such operations, be reduced.

act_name: West Pakistan Survey and Rectangulation of Lands Ordinance, 1959
heading: Assessment and recovery of costs
title: Assessment and recovery of costs
text:
3. Assessment and recovery of costs. The cost of the survey, and rectangulation operations shall be assessed and recovered from the persons whose holdings are affected in such manner as may be prescribed by rules made under this Ordinance:
Provided that the Provincial Government may remit, in whole or in part, the cost of such operations.
raw_text:
3. Assessment and recovery of costs. The cost of the survey, and rectangulation operations 
shall be assessed and recovered from the persons whose holdings are affected in such manner as may 
be prescribed by rules made under this Ordinance: 
Provided that the Provincial Government may remit, in whole or in part, the cost of such 
operations.

act_name: West Pakistan Survey and Rectangulation of Lands Ordinance, 1959
heading: Penalty
title: Penalty
text: 4. Penalty. Whoever obstructs or prevents any operations under this Ordinance, or fails to comply with any provisions of the rules made thereunder, shall, on a complaint made in writing by any Revenue Officer, be punished with imprisonment which may extend to six months, or with fine which may extend to one thousand rupees or with both.

comply with any provisions of the rules made thereunder, shall, on a complaint made in writing by any 
Revenue Officer, be punished with imprisonment which may extend to six months, or with fine which 
may extend to one thousand rupees or with both.

heading: Bar to jurisdiction of Civil Courts
title: Bar to jurisdiction of Civil Courts
text: 6. Bar to jurisdiction of Civil Courts. No Civil Court shall have jurisdiction to entertain any claim, suit or other legal proceedings in respect of any act done in pursuance of the provisions of this Ordinance.
